content.text: {"version": "1", "text": "The glossy red pumps, olive double-breasted blazer, multi-patterned bag, and golden earrings bring warm, structured accents to the soft grey dress. I chose the heels to bring a touch of polished elegance to your restaurant date, while their low kitten heel keeps you entirely comfortable throughout the evening.", "how_to_wear": ["Keep the dress cinched at the gathered waist so the soft silhouette maintains a clear anchor.", "Layer the fitted blazer over the dress to sharpen the overall line."], "wrong_photos": ["#35·42"], "named": [{"n": "#500·07", "what": "red pumps"}, {"n": "#30·23", "what": "olive double-breasted blazer"}, {"n": "#35·42", "what": "multi-patterned bag"}, {"n": "#100·34", "what": "golden earrings"}, {"n": "#117·32", "what": "grey dress"}], "about_items": [{"n": "#117·32", "text": "A grey midi shirt dress with button fastenings down the front, three-quarter sleeves with gathered cuffs, a classic collar, and an elasticated waistline."}, {"n": "#30·23", "text": "An olive double-breasted blazer with a fitted cut."}, {"n": "#500·07", "text": "Glossy red pointed-toe slingback pumps set on low kitten heels and finished with delicate cord bows across the vamp."}, {"n": "#35·42", "text": "A structured shoulder bag featuring a rich reddish-brown flap and strap paired with a geometric patterned body in warm yellow, red, and turquoise tones."}, {"n": "#100·34", "text": "A single golden hoop earring featuring a graphic nail motif, presented inside a red presentation box."}]}
